goal: Research terrain tile bending, seam stitching, and crack-free heightfield mesh generation.

v0_recommendation_summary.vertex_model: center vertex per cell; six shared corner vertices; optional six shared edge midpoint vertices; one final height per shared vertex
v0_recommendation_summary.face_model: indexed triangles; 6 top triangles without midpoints or 12 top triangles with midpoints
v0_recommendation_summary.seam_ownership: interior edges owned by sorted adjacent cell pair; interior corners owned by sorted incident cell set; boundary edges/corners owned by boundary keys
v0_recommendation_summary.height_rule: solve shared vertex heights once before emitting faces; roads and pads are constraints; no per-cell seam height overrides
v0_recommendation_summary.first_test_scene: 7-cell cluster with shared surface, smooth slope, road blend, hard step, cliff drop, and building pad seam cases
